description: Harness version pins only (ADR-0016 section 10). Never automerged: a bot that bumps and merges is `latest` with extra steps, adopting exactly the defaults the pin exists to hold.

customManagers.description: The `// renovate:` comment above each pin in the harness registry and the skills CLI constant.

prBodyNotes: **Do not merge before the bump checklist in [ADR-0016 section 10](docs/adr/0016-autonomous-runs.md) is done:** every flag in `HARNESSES` still parses (`--help`); the approval/sandbox default beneath them has not moved; one real unattended run against a scratch repo changed the worktree; a refusal still exits 0. A pin asserts that this version was verified against these flags.
